description: A request in its own tab: head band, then Equipment, Money (the request's financial clarity), Accounting (shown) and History. v = fxRequests.request(state, id), set by loadChain on vbEnter and on every fxRefresh; actions (approveRequest, Play as …) through actChain, links through openChain, export of the tab shown through exportChain (docs/redesign/BUILDING-FUTURE-SCREENS.md).

id.description: The request's id (R1001), from its tab.

number.description: The request's number (FR-1001), from its tab.

v.description: fxRequests.request(state, id): fxViews.request with lines (details, next step), items (finance checklist with where each is done), charges, companies (totals), acc (accounting per company), history.

tab.description: The inner tab shown: equipment, money, accounting or history.

failure.description: The engine's words when the last action here did not go through (stays on the page).

fxRefresh.description: From the page module (fxPage.watch): the store changed, so loadChain runs again.
